questions.questionText: Who was the leader of the rebellion in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh during the Revolt of 1857?
questions.explanation: In Bareilly (Rohilkhand), the 1857 revolt was led by Khan Bahadur Khan, a descendant of Hafiz Rahmat Khan (the Rohilla chief). He declared himself the ruler of Rohilkhand and gave stiff resistance to the British forces until the rebellion was suppressed in 1858. Hence, option C is correct.

questions.questionText: In December 2022, New Zealand passed the world's first law to ban smoking for the next generation. New Zealand's national goal is to be 'smoke-free' by:
questions.explanation: In December 2022, New Zealand passed groundbreaking legislation prohibiting the sale of tobacco to anyone born on or after January 1, 2009. questions.questionText: The Constitution of India initially permitted the use of English language for all official purposes of the Union for a period of:
questions.explanation: Under Article 343(2) of the Constitution of India, it was provided that for a period of 15 years from the commencement of the Constitution (i.e., until January 26, 1965), the English language would continue to be used for all official purposes of the Union. Later, the Official Languages Act, 1963 allowed its continued use. Hence, option C is correct.

questions.questionText: Which of the following protections is NOT a part of Article 20 of the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: Article 20 of the Constitution provides three explicit constitutional protections: (1) Protection against ex-post facto laws [Art. 20(1)], (2) Protection against double jeopardy [Art. 20(2)], and (3) Protection against self-incrimination [Art. 20(3)]. Prohibition against torture is read into the right to life and personal liberty under Article 21, not Article 20. Hence, option A is correct.

questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संरक्षण भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 20 का भाग नहीं है?
optionsHi: यातना के विरुद्ध निषेध (Prohibition Against Torture)
स्वयं के विरुद्ध साक्ष्य देने से निषेध (Prohibition against Self-Incrimination)
कार्य-उत्तर विधियों से संरक्षण (Ex-post Facto Law)
दोहरे दंड से संरक्षण (Double Jeopardy Clause)
questions.explanationHi: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 20 में तीन सुरक्षात्मक प्रावधान हैं: (1) कार्योत्तर विधियों से संरक्षण [अनुच्छेद 20(1)], (2) दोहरे दंड से संरक्षण [अनुच्छेद 20(2)], तथा (3) आत्म-अभिशंसन से संरक्षण [अनुच्छेद 20(3)]। यातना के विरुद्ध संरक्षण अनुच्छेद 21 (प्राण एवं दैहिक स्वतंत्रता) के अंतर्गत आता है, अनुच्छेद 20 में नहीं। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।

questions.questionText: 'Milind Panho' is an ancient Buddhist text written in the form of a dialogue between Indo-Greek King Menander (Milinda) and which Buddhist saint/monk?

questions.questionText: Balancing the need to use resources and also conserving them for the future generations is defined as:
questions.explanation: According to the Brundtland Commission Report (1987), 'Sustainable development is development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.' (D) Riyaz-ul-Insha

List-II (Context / Subject)

Hence, the correct matching code is A-(4), B-(2), C-(1), D-(3). Option B is correct.

questions.explanationHi:
सही सुमेलन निम्नलिखित है:

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is NOT TRUE regarding the 'Gram Sabha' under the Panchayati Raj System?
options: It exercises powers and performs functions at the village level as provided by law
Its powers and functions are determined by the Central Government
It is a body consisting of all persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village comprised within the area of Panchayat
questions.explanation: Under Article 243A of the Constitution of India, a Gram Sabha may exercise such powers and perform such functions at the village level as the Legislature of a State may, by law, provide. questions.questionText: In the administrative terminology of medieval India, who among the following officers was known as the 'Khareetadar'?
options: Despatcher of royal decrees and diplomatic letters
Main custodian of the royal palace
An officer trained in keeping treasury accounts
questions.explanation: In medieval Indian and Mughal diplomacy, 'Khareeta' referred to a silk envelope or pouch used for official royal correspondence between sovereigns and nobles. Aruna Asaf Ali famously hoisted the Indian flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan on August 9, 1942. Shanti Ghosh (along with Suniti Choudhury) was an armed revolutionary who assassinated British District Magistrate C.G.B. Stevens in December 1931, not during the 1942 movement. Hence, option D is correct.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following sacred places (Panch Prayag) is the confluence of the river Alaknanda and the river Bhagirathi?
questions.explanation:
In Uttarakhand, the five holy confluences (Panch Prayag) of the Alaknanda River are:
1. Vishnuprayag: Alaknanda + Dhauliganga
2. Nandaprayag: Alaknanda + Nandakini
3. Karnaprayag: Alaknanda + Pindar
4. Rudraprayag: Alaknanda + Mandakini
5. Devprayag: Alaknanda + Bhagirathi (downstream of Devprayag, the combined stream is officially called the Ganga). Hence, option D is correct.
